verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a coding agent with CLI, local and cloud modes, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The ability to run locally or self-host is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
